In this video we cover:
Reliance Infra x Dassault: A New Beginning?
Once part of Anil Ambani’s troubled empire, Reliance Infrastructure is making a comeback with a major defence pivot. Its new partnership with France’s Dassault Aviation will produce Falcon 2000 jets in Nagpur—Dassault’s first such move outside France. With improving financials and fresh defence contracts, can this be the revival moment Reliance Infra needs?
